main_body: bare birch tree with snow at base and branch tips
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat 2D front silhouette: the trunk is a straight 4px-wide vertical bar (rows 16-45) and the branches fan out flatly to left and right with a flat horizontal cut at row 0, showing no 3/4 canopy volume or top surface except a tiny 4px snow oval at the base.

style.evidence: The trunk consists of 3 vertical columns of flat grey/white tones with simple black rectangles, and single-pixel stick branches. Compared to the lush, multi-stepped, heavily textured reference trees (even accounting for a bare winter tree, the trunk and root structure lack organic shading, roots, and pixel density).
